# Cases for the cpp_reference test. One per line: name<TAB>spec, where spec is
#   file:PATH   a file, relative to the repository's tests/ directory
#   str:TEXT    bytes with \n \r \t \0 \\ and \xNN escapes
#   hex:DIGITS  bytes in hex
# expected.txt holds what the C++ reference logic makes of each one;
# add a case here and run regen.sh to record it.
